meta.name: ai-image-generation
meta.description: Generate AI images with FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve and 50+ models via inference.sh CLI. Models: FLUX Dev LoRA, FLUX.2 Klein LoRA, Gemini 3 Pro Image, Grok Imagine, Seedream 4.5, Reve, ImagineArt. Capabilities: text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA, image editing, upscaling, text rendering. Use for: AI art, product mockups, concept art, social media graphics, marketing visuals, illustrations. Triggers: flux, image generation, ai image, text to image, stable diffusion, generate image, ai art, midjourney alternative, dall-e alternative, text2img, t2i, image generator, ai picture, create image with ai, generative ai, ai illustration, grok image, gemini image

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入文字就能生成图片，支持改图与放大
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你需要为文章、演示或社交平台快速配图，且不愿学复杂绘图软件。
copy.tagline_en: Type a description to generate images, with editing and upscaling built in.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick images for articles, posts, or product ideas without complex tools.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会多出调用 inference.sh 命令行工具的能力,可生成、编辑图片,调用 50 多个模型(FLUX、Gemini、Grok、Seedream 等),支持文生图、图生图、局部重绘、放大、文字渲染等。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成或编辑图片,或提到 flux、ai image 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 生成一张宇航员猫在太空的图片
say.note: 会用 FLUX Dev LoRA 出图
调用 Topaz Upscaler 处理

say.text: 用 Seedream 4.5 画一张金色黄昏的人像

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the inference.sh CLI to generate and edit images, calling 50+ models (FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, etc.) and supporting text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, upscaling, text rendering, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to generate or edit an image, or mentions keywords like 'flux' or 'ai image'.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a cat astronaut in space
Use Seedream 4.5 to create a golden-hour portrait
